GRADE 7 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 80 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. This mock paper follows CBC assessment style.
2. Answer all questions.
3. Manage your time carefully.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Ulumul Qur’an at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. state the reasons for the revelation of the Qur’an as a guide to mankind,
   B. Learners should ignore Ulumul Qur’an completely.
   C. Ulumul Qur’an is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Ulumul Qur’an.

2. About Ulumul Qur’an at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the stages of the revelation of the Qur’an as a sign of mercy to mankind,
   B. Learners should ignore Ulumul Qur’an completely.
   C. Ulumul Qur’an is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Ulumul Qur’an.

3. About Ulumul Qur’an when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. narrate the incident of the first revelation of the Qur’an at Cave Hira to show the importance of seeking knowledge,
   B. Learners should ignore Ulumul Qur’an completely.
   C. Ulumul Qur’an is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Ulumul Qur’an.

5. About Selected Chapters 90:1 at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. read surah Ad-Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al-Balad (Q. 90:1-20) correctly for spiritual nourishment,
   B. Learners should ignore Selected Chapters 90:1 completely.
   C. Selected Chapters 90:1 is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Selected Chapters 90:1.

6. About Selected Chapters 90:1 at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the meaning of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) for better understanding,
   B. Learners should ignore Selected Chapters 90:1 completely.
   C. Selected Chapters 90:1 is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Selected Chapters 90:1.

7. About Selected Chapters 90:1 when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. deduce the lessons of surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93: 1-11) and surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) for application in daily life,
   B. Learners should ignore Selected Chapters 90:1 completely.
   C. Selected Chapters 90:1 is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Selected Chapters 90:1.

9. About Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the meaning of hadith for better understanding,
   B. Learners should ignore Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith completely.
   C. Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith.

10. About Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the forms of Hadith for a better understanding of the science of Hadith (Qaul, Fiil, Taqrir, Sifat),
   B. Learners should ignore Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith completely.
   C. Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith.

11. About Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. state the components of Hadith for a better understanding of the science of Hadith,

   C. Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith.

13. About Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends at home with your family, which statement is correct?

   C. Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends.

   A. assess the relevance of the selected Hadith in the life of a Muslim,

   A. practise the teachings from the selected hadith in daily life,

   B. Learners should ignore Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  completely.
